verified_key_information_units.information: The Group reported strong headline financial performance in 2025 with total revenue of EUR 53.2 million (2024: EUR 18.2 million), gross profit of EUR 18.8 million (35% margin, 2024: EUR 5.4 million, 30%), operating profit of EUR 14.7 million (2024: EUR 0.1 million), net profit of EUR 12.0 million (2024: EUR 3.9 million loss), earnings per share of EUR 0.22 (2024: EUR -0.06), and operating cash flow generating EUR 10.8 million (2024: EUR 10.4 million used). Total assets increased to EUR 124,490 thousand (2024: EUR 118,758 thousand), total equity rose to EUR 63,327 thousand (2024: EUR 51,221 thousand), with cash of EUR 5,143 thousand (2024: EUR 4,344 thousand), net asset value per share of EUR 1.12 (2024: EUR 0.89), and debt-to-equity ratio improving to 0.97 (2024: 1.32).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report - Key financials; Key performance indicators table; Consolidated interim statements of comprehensive income and financial position

candidate_sentences.text: Total revenue for 2025 reached 53.2 million euros, representing a substantial increase from 18.2 million euros in 2024.
Gross profit for the full year 2025 surged to 18.8 million euros with a 35 percent gross margin, compared to 5.4 million euros and a 30 percent margin in 2024.
Operating profit experienced a dramatic increase to 14.7 million euros, up from 0.1 million euros in the previous year.
The Group successfully shifted from a net loss of 3.9 million euros in 2024 to a net profit of 12.0 million euros for the twelve months of 2025.
Basic earnings per share improved to 0.22 euros for 2025, recovering from negative 0.06 euros in 2024.
Operating cash flow turned positive, generating 10.8 million euros in 2025, contrasting with cash usage of 10.4 million euros during 2024.
Total assets increased to 124.5 million euros as of 31 December 2025, up from 118.8 million euros a year earlier.
Total equity rose to 63.3 million euros from 51.2 million euros, and net asset value per share increased to 1.12 euros from 0.89 euros.

verified_key_information_units.information: Revenue growth was primarily driven by the handover of completed residential units in the Kalaranna District and Uus-Kindrali developments in Tallinn, as well as the City Villas project in Vilnius, contrasting lower 2024 revenue due to delayed starts in Kalaranna and limited sales elsewhere.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Management report - Revenue from real estate sales section

candidate_sentences.text: The surge in real estate revenue was primarily the result of handing over completed apartments in the Kalaranna and Uus-Kindrali developments in Tallinn, as well as the City Villas project in Vilnius, whereas apartment handovers in 2024 were much more limited as Kalaranna handovers only commenced in December of that year.

verified_key_information_units.information: Segmental revenue shifted significantly, with Estonia contributing 75% of total revenue in 2025 (versus 27% in 2024), Latvia's contribution falling to 0.3% (from 25%), and Lithuania maintaining a stable 12% share (versus 11% in 2024).
Liquidity and capital position improved, supported by active management of bank loans and bonds.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Key performance indicators table; Financing sources and policies section

candidate_sentences.text: During the reporting period, the Group engaged in significant debt and operational activities.
On 20 August 2025, the Group partially repaid 9.4 million euros of its senior secured callable fixed rate bonds, reducing the outstanding nominal amount to 10.5 million euros.
Total bank loan debt stood at 23.6 million euros at the end of the year, following total bank loan receipts of 31.5 million euros and repayments of 25.7 million euros during the period.

verified_key_information_units.information: Major real estate developments advanced: completion of the white building in Uus-Kindrali (Tallinn) with 39 units closed by year-end (78% of sellable area sold); construction commenced on the Blue Marine project in Riga's Klīversala Quarter; first real rights agreements signed and units handed over in Šaltinių Namai Attico (Vilnius); and building permit obtained for the Borgo luxury residential complex in Vilnius (construction planned for H2 2026).
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Chairman’s summary; Overview of the development projects section

candidate_sentences.text: Operational milestones during the year included completing construction on the Kalaranna District and the white building at Uus-Kindrali in Tallinn, commencing construction on the Blue Marine project in Riga, and completing the City Villas stage in Vilnius with initial customer handovers in December 2025.

verified_key_information_units.information: Hotel operations performed slightly below budget for the full year 2025, with occupancy levels softening towards year-end, though food and beverage revenue increased modestly year-on-year. Italian operations (Preatoni Nuda Proprietà and Preatoni Intermediazioni Immobiliari) faced a challenging market with subdued transaction volumes.
verified_key_information_units.source_evidence: Hotel operations section; Other operations section

verified_key_information_units.information: The Group acquired an additional 10% stake in Preatoni Nuda Proprietà S.r.l. in September 2025, increasing its ownership to 77.5%, and recognized a full impairment loss of EUR 863 thousand on the associated goodwill due to revised profitability projections and financing dependencies.
